newsitem.title: POLAND: ING Barings rates Relpol as "buy".
newsitem.headline: ING Barings rates Relpol as "buy".

text.p: ING Barings in London rated Polish electromagnetic transmitters maker Relpol SA a buy, saying the company's projected earnings per share growth was at 79.2 percent.

ING Barings said in its Eastern Europe monthly report that taking into account Relpol's February 28 price of 88 zlotys its 1997 P/E was at 9.7 thanks to the expected spectacular earnings per share growth to 9.04 zlotys in 1997.
"Despite a 47 percent price appreciation, it is still valued at only 9.7 1997 earnings, a 41 percent discount to the industrial average of 16.3," the report said.
Relpol closed at 109 zlotys on Thursday.
